name: Strict Git
description: Stricter git protections: blocks force pushes, rebases, history \ rewriting, blind staging, and direct pushes to default branches

destructive_patterns.name: push-force-any
destructive_patterns.description: Force push (even with --force-with-lease) can rewrite remote history. Disabled in strict mode.

destructive_patterns.name: push-mirror
destructive_patterns.description: git push --mirror force-updates and deletes remote refs. Disabled in strict mode.

destructive_patterns.name: push-dynamic-argument
destructive_patterns.description: Force push risk: a shell-expanded or escaped git push argument cannot be verified as non-forcing. Use literal remote and refspec arguments in strict mode.

destructive_patterns.name: rebase
destructive_patterns.description: git rebase rewrites commit history. Disabled in strict mode.

destructive_patterns.name: commit-amend
destructive_patterns.description: git commit --amend rewrites the last commit. Disabled in strict mode.

destructive_patterns.name: cherry-pick
destructive_patterns.description: git cherry-pick can introduce duplicate commits. Review carefully.

destructive_patterns.name: filter-branch
destructive_patterns.description: git filter-branch rewrites entire repository history. Extremely dangerous!

destructive_patterns.name: filter-repo
destructive_patterns.description: git filter-repo rewrites repository history. Review carefully.

destructive_patterns.name: reflog-expire
destructive_patterns.description: git reflog expire removes reflog entries needed for recovery.

destructive_patterns.name: gc-aggressive
destructive_patterns.description: git gc with aggressive/prune options can remove recoverable objects.

destructive_patterns.name: worktree-remove
destructive_patterns.description: git worktree remove deletes a linked working tree.

destructive_patterns.name: submodule-deinit
destructive_patterns.description: git submodule deinit removes submodule configuration.

destructive_patterns.name: add-all-dot
destructive_patterns.description: git add . stages everything including secrets, .env files, and build artifacts. Use 'git add <specific-files>' instead.

destructive_patterns.name: add-all-flag
destructive_patterns.description: git add -A/--all stages all changes including secrets, .env files, and build artifacts. Use 'git add <specific-files>' instead.

destructive_patterns.name: push-master
destructive_patterns.description: Direct push to master is blocked. Use a feature branch and open a Pull Request.

destructive_patterns.name: push-main
destructive_patterns.description: Direct push to main is blocked. Use a feature branch and open a Pull Request.
